description: REQ-P4 violation discovered during in-cycle audit. behavioral-spec.md:84-86 mandates 'AS STEP 3, THE SYSTEM SHALL invoke health-check.py --fix <slot>'. proactive-loop-dispatch.py:57-62 does NOT invoke health-check.py at all. It writes a status line 'step=3-health-check' (cosmetic), then reads .unfixable.jsonl byte-count to compute 'unfixable_count'. There is no subprocess invocation of health-check.py, no call into lib.health_check_v2.dispatch_highest_priority, no auto-fix path. REQ-P4 was the unifying glue between Group P (proactive loop) and Group H (health check). With STEP 3 a no-op, the entire Group H auto-recovery surface (REQ-H1..H6, including the FIND-2-002 / FIND-3-001 enumeration issue, all PROP-H3 dispatch correctness) is dead code in the production cron path. PROP-P4-health-call (verification-architecture.md:60-61 'integration-test (health-check stubbed)') CANNOT pass against this implementation.
